# Velora Proposal 2026-05-14

The 16-page proposal I submitted to Velora Mobility at 09:00 on 2026-05-14, built on the old [[proposal-template-2025]].

## Summary

One fixed fee of $74,000 for 14 weeks: rider research (12 interviews, 2 rounds of testing with 8 riders each), redesign of the four core flows, a component set in Velora's Figma, and handoff with two weeks of developer support. Payment 50% deposit, then milestones, per the [[standard-services-agreement]].

## Key Details

- Structure: problem understanding (2 pages), approach (4), research plan (2), timeline (1), about me (2), case studies (3), price (1), terms (1).
- Case studies: Crumbhollow, Thistlewood and the native app concepts for "a financial client". All screens, no numbers.
- Team: me. One sentence on bringing in "trusted specialists if needed".
- Price page: one number.

## Why It Matters

The document behind the loss. Read next to the [[velora-feedback-call-2026-06-03]], each of the three reasons is visible on a specific page: the single price page, the case study pages and the one-sentence team section. The rewrite is the [[proposal-template-2026]].

## Caveats

The approach and research plan were good, according to Annika; they were reused almost unchanged in the new template's research section.

## Source Location

PDF and source file in my drive under Sales/2026/Velora. Velora's internal data quoted in an appendix was removed after the NDA closure.
